title: Hollow-Fiber Membrane Degassing Module for Inkjet Ink
seoTitle: EF-AG3-B Hollow-Fiber Membrane Degassing Module for Inkjet Ink | FOREACH
description: EF-AG3-B removes dissolved gases from industrial inkjet ink inline. Two liquid ports and one vacuum port use NPT 1/8 female threads.
introduction: The EF-AG3-B degasses ink inline in industrial inkjet supply lines. Ink flows outside the hollow fibers, and the vacuum draws dissolved gases through the membrane to reduce bubble formation downstream. Both liquid ports and the vacuum port use NPT 1/8 female threads. Verify degassing and liquid-side pressure drop for the actual ink, flow rate, temperature and vacuum-side absolute pressure, and check compatibility with ink and cleaning fluids.

selection.intro: EF-AG3-B uses an external-perfusion design: liquid flows outside the hollow fibers, and dissolved gases pass through the membrane and are drawn away on the vacuum side. First establish the operating flow rate, degassing target and allowable pressure drop, then check liquid temperature, fluid compatibility and available vacuum conditions.

inputs.title: Operating flow rate and degassing target
inputs.intro: Define the following inputs for actual equipment operation, then check the target operating point against the reference curves.
rows: Record the usual and maximum equipment flow rates
Check both continuous liquid delivery and start/stop conditions.
Assess performance using dissolved oxygen concentrations before and after treatment
Validate against printhead jetting or equipment operation.
Check the module's liquid-side pressure drop at the target flow rate
Include pressure losses through filters, tubing and fittings.
Select a reference curve for the actual liquid temperature and vacuum-side absolute pressure
Check operating vacuum conditions against the liquid's saturated vapor pressure.

materials.title: Wetted materials and fluid compatibility
materials.intro: Check both the process liquid and the cleaning liquid. Record their composition, concentration, temperature and contact time.
materials.paragraph: The hollow fibers are PMP; the housing and end caps use PP and stainless steel, with epoxy potting resin. Confirm compatibility against the complete combination of wetted materials.

curves.title: Flow rate, degassing performance and liquid-side pressure drop
curves.intro: At the target flow rate, read dissolved oxygen removal at the relevant vacuum condition and the corresponding liquid-side pressure drop. Series water tests show decreasing oxygen removal and increasing pressure drop as flow rises. At the same temperature and flow, curves at lower vacuum-side absolute pressure indicate higher reference removal rates.
curves.note: The curves are approximate redrawings of series water-test reference graphs. Validate the actual equipment with its intended fluid, liquid temperature and target operating point.
alts: Reference curves of flow rate versus dissolved oxygen removal: water at 25 °C and 2.7, 6.7 or 13.3 kPa absolute, plus water at 45 °C and 6.7 kPa absolute
Series reference curve showing liquid-side pressure drop rising with flow rate in water tests at 25 °C
captions: Flow rate and dissolved oxygen removal. Select the curve for liquid temperature and vacuum-side absolute pressure, then read removal at the target flow rate.
Flow rate and liquid-side pressure drop. Read the pressure drop at the same flow rate and compare it with the equipment's available pressure margin.
curves.example: For water at 25 °C and 1,000 mL/min, the 6.7 kPa vacuum-side absolute-pressure curve indicates approximately 58% dissolved oxygen removal. At the same flow rate, water-test liquid-side pressure drop is approximately 2.3 kPa. Both values are approximate readings from series reference graphs.

ports.title: Port identification and installation clearance
ports.intro: Both liquid ports and the vacuum port are NPT 1/8. The side port and one end port carry liquid; the other end port connects to vacuum. Check the port markings before connecting tubing. Allow space for connections based on the 159 mm overall length, Ø42 mm end-cap diameter and side-port location.

connections.title: Ink supply and vacuum lines
connections.intro: First determine the module's position in the ink supply circuit. A filter is recommended in the liquid circuit; its location follows the equipment design.
rows: Ink tank → supply pump → membrane degassing module → reservoir → printhead
In this example, liquid enters through the lower side port and exits through the upper end port. Some systems locate the module between the reservoir and printhead; follow the actual ink circuit.
Vacuum port → liquid trap → vacuum pump

Fit a vacuum gauge to read absolute pressure. The liquid trap collects condensate or leaking liquid, helping identify leaks and protect the vacuum pump. For aqueous ink applications, orienting the vacuum port downwards is recommended.

commissioning.title: Initial priming and operating-point validation
commissioning.intro: Check orientation and port connections, fill and vent the module, then verify degassing performance and pressure drop at the target flow rate.
steps: Confirm the liquid inlet, liquid outlet and vacuum port against their markings, and check that the liquid trap and vacuum gauge are connected.
Fill slowly from the lower liquid port
Introduce liquid gradually to displace air from the module; applied vacuum can assist venting. Initial priming volume is approximately 40 mL, a series reference value.
Set vacuum conditions for the actual liquid temperature

During operation, vacuum-side absolute pressure should not fall below the liquid's saturated vapor pressure at the operating temperature, to avoid excessive evaporation affecting the liquid composition or vacuum pump.
Validate at the target flow rate

Record the fluid, liquid temperature, flow rate and vacuum-side absolute pressure. Measure dissolved oxygen before and after treatment with a dissolved oxygen meter and record liquid-side pressure drop with a differential pressure gauge. Check the degassing target and available circuit pressure margin.

storage.title: Routine checks and storage
storage.intro: After changes in operating conditions, record flow rate, liquid temperature, vacuum-side absolute pressure and liquid-side pressure drop again. Check the trap for condensate or signs of liquid leakage.
storage.paragraph: Store indoors in a dry location below 45 °C and away from direct sunlight. Prevent any water remaining in the module after use from freezing.
